text: Open Crafting Atlas to search recipes, ingredients and products. Recipes may require research, tools, a workbench, an era or a particular game mode. The atlas includes alternative catalogs; an entry alone does not prove it is unlocked on your current map.

Cover exposed body parts and wear a coat over ordinary clothing. Rain and immersion make you wet, reducing insulation. Seek dry shelter and warmth from a lit nearby brazier, campfire, furnace or fireplace. Shelter alone may still be cold. Clothing buys time but does not provide immunity to hypothermia.

Bandages treat external wounds on the selected body part. They do not immediately restore damage or replace lost blood. Internal bleeding and severed arteries can continue despite bandaging. Check other wounded body parts and seek further treatment.
